relations: The burning stick pile produces swaying orange flame tongues and a pulsing yellow core.
Detached orange flecks drift rightward from the main flame column and vanish.
The background crop field, palms, hills, and sky remain motionless.
A horizontal boundary crosses the upper flame, separating sharp details from a diffuse glow.
caption: The video captures a low pile of dry sticks and branches burning on bare ground, backed by a flat green crop field. A cluster of palm trees stands on the right, while distant hills and a few small buildings sit beneath a low sun sinking into orange-pink clouds. The framing stays fixed, so the horizon, palms, structures and stick pile hold their positions throughout. The fire is already established and continues to burn, its bright yellow base core pulsing in size and brightness. Orange flame tongues rise, thin, lean left or right, and re-form as the column's silhouette sways taller and shorter from frame to frame. A straight horizontal line crosses the upper flame, below which the fire looks sharp and detailed and above which the glow reads softer and more diffuse. Small detached orange flecks occasionally drift to the right of the main column and vanish, while the ground, field and sky remain motionless.
